subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent` permanently cap message-file input at 4 MiB while continuing to accept symlinked paths?
rationale: The implementation safely fixes the memory-allocation bug, but neither an existing shared agent-input budget nor current documentation establishes the exact 4 MiB ceiling, and the overlapping PR selects a conflicting symlink policy.

options.title: Adopt 4 MiB and symlinks
options.body: Keep this focused patch, document the limit, and require future file/stdin work to preserve the same contract.

options.title: Unify in broader input PR
options.body: Pause this PR and move the bounded-read fix into the broader file/stdin change after that branch adopts an owner-approved compatibility policy.

options.title: Choose another ceiling
options.body: Replace 4 MiB with a maintainer-selected agent or gateway input budget and update the implementation, tests, and docs consistently.

recommendation.title: Adopt 4 MiB and symlinks
recommendation.body: Keep this focused patch, document the limit, and require future file/stdin work to preserve the same contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent current-main owner signal for this command boundary and can coordinate the conflicting open implementation.
